### Downsizing Data

> Keep 10%

```{python}
# Separate neurons and non-neurons
neurons = df[df['Cell_class'].isin(['Inhibitory', 'Excitatory'])]
non_neurons = df[~df['Cell_class'].isin(['Inhibitory', 'Excitatory'])]
print(f"Original: {len(neurons):,} neurons, {len(non_neurons):,} non-neurons")
```

```{python}
df_sample =  df.sample(frac = 0.08, random_state = 42)
```

```{python}
print(f"Sampled: {len(df_sample):,} cells")
print(f"Final memory: {df_sample.memory_usage(deep=True).sum() / 1e6:.1f} MB")
print(df_sample['Cell_class'].value_counts())
```

### Export Downsized Data (Downsized by `Excitatory` / `Inhibitory` class)

```{python}
df_sample.to_csv('data/processed/merfish_downsampled.csv', index=False)
print("Saved sampled data for group use.")
```
